sql.if: and (h.item_name like concat('%', #{pager.searchKeyword}, '%') or h.item_category like concat('%', #{pager.searchKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: group by h.gym_id, h.item_category, h.item_name having sum(h.item_count) > 0
mapper.select: select gym_id from "h_member" where username = #{username} and upper(role) = 'OWNER'
select gym_id from "h_member" where username = #{username} and upper(role) in ('OWNER', 'TRAINER')
select distinct item_name as itemName, item_category as itemCategory from "h_item" where gym_id=#{gymId} order by item_name
mapper.delete: delete from "h_item" where item_id=#{itemId} and gym_id=#{gymId}
mapper.select: select * from "h_item" where item_count > 0 and item_expiry_date = current_date + interval '3 day'

select gym_id as gymId, item_category as itemCategory, item_name as itemName, sum(item_count) as itemCount from "h_item" where gym_id = #{gymId} and item_category = #{category} group by gym_id, item_category, item_name having sum(item_count) > 0 order by itemCount desc, item_name
